method: Each piece is one quarter of a 2×2 picture. All four images of a Pokémon V-UNION were read (shrunk and cropped) and compared field by field with the combined block the text source (MIK) carries on every piece; the placement rule and the V-UNION rule box are transcribed from the images. Piece order is the printed number order (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right).

unions.name: 甲贺忍蛙V-UNION
unions.combinedFields: every field of the shared metadata blocks[0] (HP, type, attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, Retreat) matches the four images word for word
unions.placementRule: 对战中有1次机会，在自己的回合，可将自己弃牌区中的4种甲贺忍蛙 V-UNION 组合起来，放于备战区。
unions.ruleBox: 当宝可梦 V-UNION 昏厥时，对手将拿取3张奖赏卡。
